//note_CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH: MACHINE-SPECIFIC — on a different PC, delete the CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH line in env above (and this note). It is only needed here because Git for Windows is installed under %LOCALAPPDATA% (a non-standard location) that Claude Code's auto-detection misses, and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0 disables the PowerShell fallback, so startup fails without it. A standard C:\Program Files\Git install is detected automatically.
